description: Automatic power factor controller with up to 13 capacitor steps, Modbus over RS485 or Ethernet

sources.title: EPFCB - Registers Modbus
sources.note: all three pages: input registers and holding registers

notes: Power factor controller EPFCB. The manual file is named EPFC and its table is titled EPFCB.
Serial Modbus must be switched on in the setup (A.05 Serial protocol = Modbus, address 1-199); with A.04 set to Ethernet the controller uses the IP address and port from A.06.
The manual does not give the order of the two words of a 32-bit or 64-bit value, nor the factory serial settings. Big word order is assumed; check it against the display.
The single alarm bits of the 32-bit alarm words assume the high word is at the lower address.
Addresses 0x0048-0x004C and 0x0058-0x005C are not described in the manual.
Temperatures are in the unit chosen by A.07 (degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit).

registers.name: General alarms
registers.description: One bit per alarm, 1 = active. The manual lists this as a 16-bit value but uses bit 31, so it is read here as two registers. Bits: 0 voltage too high, 1 voltage too low, 2 current too high, 3 current too low, 4 overcompensation, 5 undercompensation, 6 over temperature, 7 high THD V, 8 high THD I, 9 minimum cos, 10 external over temperature, 31 wrong frequency
